raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 2026-01-17 source change moved reversals to separate REVERSAL records and stopped updating originals, but silver_transactions keeps only status='POSTED', so reversal amounts are dropped while the original sales stay counted, inflating gold totals. Since raw amounts have a positive minimum (2.34) across all statuses, REVERSAL amounts are positive magnitudes and must be netted as negatives.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.55, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(CASE WHEN status = 'REVERSAL' THEN -amount ELSE amount END AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status IN ('POSTED', 'REVERSAL');"}}
